correctness.rationale: Since each quotient has radical length two, its third radical power vanishes; f of order ≥3 disappears in R/m³. The closed radical-square-zero locus is Gr(2,2d). In the other radical filtration (d,1,1), multiplication stability reduces to rank-one of a 2×2d catalecticant [A B; B C]; its projective rank-one locus is P^{d−1}×P¹ by explicit characteristic-independent charts. Each point has all graph lifts Hom(U,V2/W), rank2d−1, establishing the vector bundle. Gaussian identity yields normalized t². The finite script verified formulas for d≤3, q=2,3; it is explicitly not an infinite proof.
